svg.title: Microkernel (Plug-in)
svg.desc: Microkernel (Plug-in). A minimal core system extended by independent plug-in modules. Step 1, A small core, plug-ins: At start-up the core reads each plug-in's manifest, registers it and wires its contributions in. Step 2, Add without touching core: Markdown preview is installed and starts when the first .md file opens; the core is not redeployed. Step 3, Contain a hung plug-in: Git hangs in a loop. The editor stays responsive; the core restarts the plug-in host without Git. Step 4, The API is the hard part: API v2 renames a method: v1 plug-ins work through a compat layer, and a 0.x plug-in is refused.
